picks.thesis: Same-day direction call by the 11:20 rule: at 11:14 ET QQQ is +0.36% vs its open and above VWAP (+1.74% vs Friday), SPY and IWM also above VWAP, VIXY -4.8%. Conviction 1 only; confirm_vwap buys only while TQQQ is above its VWAP; cap 2.5% over the snapshot so a moving tape doesn't block the fill. Wrong if QQQ falls back below today's open (~$719.6); stop 4.5%.
